title: Minimize Total Waiting Time
statement:
Order independent jobs so the sum of all waiting times is as small as possible.

Contract
- `serviceTimes` is non-null and contains non-negative durations.
- If jobs are processed one at a time, a job's waiting time is the total duration of every job scheduled before it.
- Return the minimum possible sum of waiting times as a `long`.
- Do not mutate `serviceTimes`.

Examples
- `minimumTotalWaitTime(new int[]{2, 5, 1, 3})` returns `10`.
- `minimumTotalWaitTime(new int[]{7})` returns `0`.
- `minimumTotalWaitTime(new int[]{4, 4, 4})` returns `12`.
hints: Try writing the wait contribution of a job at position `i`.
Shorter jobs should appear earlier because they are counted in more later waits.
Sort ascending and add each duration multiplied by how many jobs remain after it. Intended complexity: O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
inputSyntax: Input: service times array, for example: [2, 5, 1, 3]
